title: Cosmic Octopus on the Moon
description: A vibrant purple octopus with yellow-ringed suckers emerges from the cratered surface of the moon, its tentacles curling upward. From its head bursts a stream of colorful fruits, dots, and smoke that flows into a starry black space filled with glowing orbs and a crescent moon.
prompt: A large vibrant purple octopus emerging from the cratered grey surface of the moon, its tentacles curling and reaching upward, head exploding into a fountain of colorful citrus fruits, glowing dots, and swirling smoke against a black cosmic background with glowing orbs and a detailed crescent moon in the sky, surreal psychedelic style, highly detailed
